Aerodynamic_Rectrices_Fan.description: This magnificent avian appendage, adorned with sleek feathers and a graceful arc, acts as a powerful aerodynamic rudder, enhancing the agility and aerial maneuverability of its bearer, allowing for swift evasive actions and mesmerizing aerial displays.

Stiffened_Woodpecker_Prop.description: This peculiar avian tail, adorned with stiff feathers that mimic the sturdy resilience of a woodpecker’s physiology, not only enhances the wearer’s climbing abilities but also bolsters their constitution and strength, granting them a formidable resistance to knockback effects.

Elongated_Display_Streamers.description: Resembling the majestic display of a peacock, the elongated, feathered streamers sway gracefully yet dramatically, enhancing the wearer's charm and charisma while simultaneously drawing attention and reducing their ability to remain hidden.

Cryptic_Bark_Mimic_Plumage.description: This avian entity, resembling a nightjar with its cryptic plumage, possesses a magnificent tail that aids in perfecting its camouflage abilities, allowing it to move silently and unseen through the shadows, though its agility is slightly hindered by the intricate layers of its feathers.

Forked_Aerodynamic_Swift_Tail.description: This forked aerodynamic tail, a marvel of avian anatomy, enhances agility and speed, allowing its bearer to execute breathtaking aerial maneuvers and cut through the skies with unmatched swiftness and grace.

Rattle_Striking_Keratin_Spikes.description: Emerging from the twisted avian physiology of this mutant creature, the Rattle_Striking_Keratin_Spikes are a set of jagged, keratinous spikes embedded along the length of its tail, designed to produce a spine-chilling rattle when shaken, enhancing its intimidation and causing bleeding upon contact.

Prehensile_Grasping_Feathered_Lure.description: The Prehensile Grasping Feathered Lure is a marvel of avian adaptation, a long, sinuous tail adorned with soft, gripping feathers that allow for effortless arboreal traversal and silent stalking, enhancing both dexterity and perception.

Aquatic_Hydrodynamic_Diving_Rudder.description: This sleek, hydrodynamic tail, reminiscent of a penguin's, thrums with aquatic grace and agility, granting its bearer unparalleled speed beneath the waves and the ability to perform swift, powerful dashes through water.

Toxic_Aposematic_Display_Vane.description: The Toxic Aposematic Display Vane is a vibrant and lethal appendage, resembling a tail with iridescent, bioluminescent feathers that warn predators of the wearer's toxicity. When unfurled, it emits a noxious poison cloud, deterring foes while enhancing the bearer’s charisma and poison resistance.

Vestigial_Uropygial_Nub.description: A small, barely noticeable appendage at the base of the spine, this vestigial uropygial nub is a remnant of avian ancestry, providing slight enhancements to stealth and constitution, though it offers no additional movement benefits.
